fusions.name: Herd Jab
fusions.desc: Thrusts the fork at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Drovers' Push
fusions.desc: Drives the target back with a heavy thrust that deals 28 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Fodder
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Grazing
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
